sections.markdown:
## E2 — Competitive teardown: pedestrians, school zones, bicycles, motorcycles, large vehicles, buses and special vehicles
No competitor was reviewed in this pass; names, prices, structure, pedagogy, practice style, praise, complaints and coverage are open (OR-SHARE-TEARDOWN).
Adopt and beat lists stay empty until at least two named, priced competitors are examined from their own store or review pages.
Angle to test later: competitors may teach generic national pedestrian and school bus rules; the Oregon signal versus no-signal crosswalk clearance and the bike box right-turn ban could be a beat point once verified.

corpus_stability.reason: The Oregon Driver Manual is a two-year edition (the front cover names a two-year span and the back cover carries a single form revision code); fees and office details are sent to the DMV website rather than printed, and nothing in the selected pages suggests more than one rewrite per year.

verification_debt.claim_text: Competitive teardown of Oregon knowledge-test prep products for the pedestrians, school zones, bicycles, motorcycles, large vehicles, buses and special vehicles topic is unresearched.
